rules.allocation: node allocatable iff adjacent to an allocated node; 'start' (The Anvil) pre-allocated; deallocation must keep the allocated subgraph connected
rules.keystones: max 3 allocated simultaneously; each keystone is gated behind exactly one notable
rules.scope: atlas stats affect world/loot/economy only - never hero combat stats

nodes.name: Anvilborn Covenant
nodes.description: Duplicate Uniques drop as Ash Essence instead of items.

nodes.name: The Anvil's Memory
nodes.description: Autosold items grant 1% of their value as Ash Essence.

nodes.name: Ash Communion
nodes.description: Ashen zones (Act 3+) drop double loot; the hero takes 15% more fire damage there.

nodes.name: Crown of the Goblin King
nodes.description: Rare monsters gain +1 affix and drop +1 item.

nodes.name: Echo of Kael
nodes.description: +40% Gold Find; item drop rate -15%. The Empire always takes its cut in kind.

nodes.name: Ember Tide
nodes.description: Rifts drop 50% more Embers, but rift timers are 25% shorter.

nodes.name: Ferek's Silent Partner
nodes.description: Gamble pity also grows by 1 per 5 minutes of play; gambling costs 25% more Gold.

nodes.name: Gilded Grudge
nodes.description: After hitting a Unique, pity resets to 20 instead of 0; gambled items cannot be sold.

nodes.name: Grand Design
nodes.description: Runes drop one tier higher; rune drop rate -20%.

nodes.name: The Horde Below
nodes.description: +35% pack size; monsters deal 10% more damage.

nodes.name: Key to the Sanctum
nodes.description: You may re-fight your highest defeated boss at will; boss loot quantity -25%.

nodes.name: The Patient Dead
nodes.description: Deaths while idle don't reset kill streaks; respawn takes 50% longer.

nodes.name: Perfected Casting
nodes.description: Cube recipes have a 25% chance to not consume the base item.

nodes.name: Sar-Hazan's Bargain
nodes.description: +25% XP gained; on death, lose 5% of the current level's XP.

nodes.name: The Still Center
nodes.description: Offline progress runs at full efficiency; online kill speed -5%.

nodes.name: The Long March
nodes.description: Rifts open 1 tier higher than selected; rift mods are 30% stronger.

nodes.name: The Ninth Batch
nodes.description: Cube outputs have a 2% chance to upgrade to Unique, and a 10% chance to come out as a hostile Slime carrying the item.

nodes.name: The Unfinished Work
nodes.description: Lord of Ash can drop Unfinished Uniques - random Uniques with one rerollable affix.

nodes.name: Trophy Room
nodes.description: Act bosses drop an extra Rare with a guaranteed T1 affix; bosses have 20% more Life.

nodes.name: Vharos' Ledger
nodes.description: The first Unique of each kind found per difficulty drops with perfect rolls; unique drop rate -10%.

nodes.name: The Anvil
nodes.description: Vharos' first anvil. All roads through the endgame begin here.
